descriptions.luaDebugMode: Toggles showing script errors. Default value: false.
descriptions.luaDeprecatedWarnings: Shows warnings for functions that should be replaced. Requires luaDebugMode.
descriptions.scriptName: Location of the Lua script currently running.
descriptions.modFolder: Mod folder where the Lua script is running.
descriptions.currentModDirectory: Custom week mod folder currently active; empty on base-game weeks.

descriptions.buildTarget: Build target, such as windows, windows_x86, or linux.

descriptions.Function_StopLua: Stops the callback only for the next Lua scripts.
descriptions.Function_StopHScript: Stops the callback only for the next HScript scripts.
descriptions.Function_StopAll: Stops the callback for the next Lua scripts and HScripts.
descriptions.Function_Stop: Cancels callbacks such as startCountdown or endSong; commonly used for cutscenes.
descriptions.Function_Continue: Lets the engine continue normally after the script runs.

descriptions.songName: Instrumental name as seen in the pause screen.
descriptions.songPath: Formatted songName in lowercase with spaces replaced by hyphens.
descriptions.loadedSongName: Song name selected from Freeplay or Story Menu.
descriptions.loadedSongPath: Formatted loadedSongName in lowercase with hyphens.
descriptions.startedCountdown: Whether the countdown already started; starts as false.
descriptions.seenCutscene: False on the first try; true after restart or death, useful for cutscene checks.
descriptions.inGameOver: Whether the game is currently in the Game Over screen.

descriptions.chartPath: Directory of the chart, including the file extension.
descriptions.curStage: Current song stage as seen in the Chart Editor.
descriptions.hasVocals: Whether the song has vocals enabled.

descriptions.difficultyPath: Difficulty formatted as a lowercase suffix; empty on Normal.

descriptions.isStoryMode: Boolean value for the current game mode.
descriptions.week: Week name as found in the weeks folder.

descriptions.curDecBeat: Current beat with decimal progress toward the next beat.
descriptions.curDecStep: Current step with decimal progress toward the next step.
descriptions.crochet: Milliseconds per beat in the current section.
descriptions.stepCrochet: Milliseconds per step in the current section.
descriptions.mustHitSection: Whether the current section targets the player.
descriptions.altAnim: Whether the current section has alt animation enabled.
descriptions.gfSection: Whether the current section targets Girlfriend.

descriptions.deaths: How many times the player has died so far.
descriptions.ratingName: Current rating label, such as Sick or Good.
descriptions.ratingFC: Full-combo state, such as Clear, SDBC, FC, GFC, or SFC.
descriptions.totalPlayed: Misses plus hits; used for rating calculation.
descriptions.totalNotesHit: Accumulated hit score used for rating calculation.

descriptions.instakillOnMiss: Whether missing instantly kills the player. Default value: false.
descriptions.practice: Whether practice mode is enabled. Default value: false.
descriptions.botPlay: Whether botplay is enabled. Default value: false.

descriptions.defaultPlayerStrumY0: Player left note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultPlayerStrumY1: Player down note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultPlayerStrumY2: Player up note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultPlayerStrumY3: Player right note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultOpponentStrumY0: Opponent left note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultOpponentStrumY1: Opponent down note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultOpponentStrumY2: Opponent up note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.
descriptions.defaultOpponentStrumY3: Opponent right note default Y: 50 upscroll, 570 downscroll.

descriptions.defaultBoyfriendX: Player group X from the stage JSON.
descriptions.defaultBoyfriendY: Player group Y from the stage JSON.
descriptions.defaultOpponentX: Opponent group X from the stage JSON.
descriptions.defaultOpponentY: Opponent group Y from the stage JSON.
descriptions.defaultGirlfriendX: Girlfriend group X from the stage JSON.
descriptions.defaultGirlfriendY: Girlfriend group Y from the stage JSON.
descriptions.boyfriendName: Current player character JSON name without extension.
descriptions.dadName: Current opponent character JSON name without extension.
descriptions.gfName: Current Girlfriend character JSON name without extension.

descriptions.ghostTapping: Allows pressing with no note penalty. Default value: true.
descriptions.hideHud: Hides HUD elements. Default value: false.
descriptions.timeBarType: Selected time bar mode. Default value: Time Left.
descriptions.scoreZoom: Enables score text zoom on hit. Default value: true.
descriptions.cameraZoomOnBeat: Enables camera zoom pulses on beat. Default value: true.
descriptions.flashingLights: Enables flashing light effects. Default value: true.
descriptions.noResetButton: Disables reset button behavior. Default value: false.
descriptions.lowQuality: Low quality preference. Default value: false.
descriptions.shadersEnabled: Whether shaders are enabled. Default value: true.
descriptions.guitarHeroSustains: Uses Guitar Hero style sustains. Default value: true.
descriptions.noteSkin: Selected note skin. Default value: Default.
descriptions.splashSkin: Selected note splash skin. Default value: Psych.
descriptions.noteSkinPostfix: Noteskin file path postfix, such as -future, -chip, or empty.
descriptions.splashSkinPostfix: Note splash file path postfix, such as -diamond, -vanilla, or empty.
